plugins.name: safespace-mcp
plugins.description: The AI safety gateway for an agent's external surface — a provider-agnostic safety envelope (sanitize, untrusted-content tagging, tier/scope/burst/recipient egress gates, autonomy hardening, audit trail) between an AI agent and any source it touches. 129 tools: Google Workspace (Gmail/Drive/Docs/Calendar/Contacts/YouTube+Analytics/Tasks/Sheets/Slides/Forms — the flagship connector), GitHub (read + allowlist-gated writes), Notion (read + sanitize-gated writes), X, a keyless SSRF-gated web_fetch, a default-deny path-gated fs_read, and LINE / Telegram / Discord / Slack / Mattermost messaging. Tier-based exposure (read|write|share); tokens behind the Keychain or an encrypted file.
